description: Start an asynchronous crawl of a site section and return a job id that can be polled for status.

allowBackwardLinks.description: When true, allow the crawl to follow links to pages above or preceding the starting URL in the site hierarchy.

allowExternalLinks.description: When true, allow the crawl to follow links to external domains.

excludePaths.description: URL path patterns to exclude from the crawl.

includePaths.description: URL path patterns to include in the crawl; when set, only matching paths are crawled.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl.

maxDepth.description: Maximum crawl depth from the starting URL.

scrapeOptions.description: Optional scrape options applied to each crawled page.

url.description: Starting URL of the site section to crawl.

name: firecrawl_crawl
